brief: Rehearses an attack on a spawned target application and reports whether the detections fired, from sealed and verified evidence.
detail: A drill spawns a target (its own ledger, auth and signed-request gate), attacks it with credential stuffing, a forged signature and a replayed request, and then learns what happened only from the ledger the target sealed to a file and the drill verified. Contain then derives a plan from that evidence, commits it as an operator, and ContainmentHolds proves from outside that the account is locked. Timings are measured: TimeToDetectMs and TimeToContainMs. SpawnTarget starts a second process and opens a port on 127.0.0.1, so a drill belongs on a machine set aside for it; the methods that only read state work without a target.
